note: One row = one experimental condition (one intervention arm scored for one task family). A paper usually yields several rows. Written as JSON Lines. Fields marked setup are the only ones the Predictor may ever see for test items.

split.desc: test only if published after the Predictor's training cutoff and passed the memorization probe

fields.paper_id: stable id, prefer DOI, else PMID, else archive URL
fields.title: string
fields.location: figure / table / text section the numbers came from
fields.lab: corresponding or last author surname (lab identity, for leave-one-lab-out)

species.desc: e.g. Dugesia japonica, Schmidtea mediterranea, Xenopus laevis

stage.desc: Nieuwkoop-Faber stage for Xenopus; fragment type for planaria (trunk, head, tail)

fields.type: enum: ion_channel_misexpression | ion_channel_knockdown | channel_or_pump_drug | gap_junction_block | gap_junction_misexpression | gap_junction_knockdown | ionophore | applied_field | ion_substitution | combination | control
fields.target: molecular target, e.g. H+/K+-ATPase, Kir2.1, innexins, V-ATPase; null for applied fields
fields.agent: drug, construct or device, e.g. octanol, SCH-28080, ivermectin, Kv1.5 mRNA
fields.timing: start relative to injury (hours post amputation, hpa) or developmental stage
fields.field_direction: applied fields only, e.g. anterior cut facing anode
fields.description: neutral one-line description of what was done. Must not mention the result.
fields.action: enum: block | open_or_activate | knockdown | overexpress | substitute_ion | apply_field | none
fields.timing_start_h: number or null; hours relative to amputation or fertilisation, negative = before
fields.duration_h: number or null; hours of exposure

outcomes.desc: [{category, count}] using only the family's categories. If only percentages are reported, convert with n_total and set outcome_from_percent true. Dead or dissolved fragments go in 'dead' counts outside the family categories (field dead_count), never in 'other'

result_is_null.desc: true when the paper reports no effect for this arm

notes.desc: for test items, notes go to the outcomes file, never the setup file

evidence_tier.desc: 1 desk or unpublished lab data, 2 post-cutoff published, 3 temporal-holdout only, 4 pre-cutoff probe-passed

arm_role.desc: extract control and vehicle arms too: they are the unbiased negative class

fields.vmem_direction_pred: depolarize | hyperpolarize | null. Set only by harness/derive_features.py from sealed kb/vmem_lookup.json; never by an extractor

source_type.desc: where the row came from; see config/sources.json

derived.desc: Top-level underscore fields (_agent_id, _components, _target_id, _target_components, _target_class, _fragment, _delivery, _field_dir, _dose_bucket, _timing_bucket, _duration_bucket, _lineage) are written by harness/derive_features.py only
